# Opening a request from your own code

`Opem.open` opens the panel on a tab, with a kind, a title or an error pinned; `reportError` pins an error's digest. Both work with the launcher hidden (`init({ launcher: false })`).

## Your own report button

Opens New request with a title and a screenshot ready, from the button's click.

```ts file=open-request.ts
reportButton.addEventListener("click", () =>
  Opem.open("request", {
    kind: "problem",
    title: "The export button does nothing",
    screenshot: true,
  }),
);
```
